platform_after:
while coroutine.status(self.co) ~= "dead" do
		cnt = cnt + 1
		-- Browser platform service progresses the retained native ZIP queue here.
		-- forceWait blocks the host event loop, so an external poll cannot do this.
		if not core.serial.browserWorkerReady or not core.serial.browserPump or not core.serial.browserError then
			error(_t"Browser save service is unavailable.")
		end
		if not core.serial.browserWorkerReady() then
			error(core.serial.browserError() or _t"Browser save service is not ready.")
		end
		local pump = core.serial.browserPump(1, 65536)
		if pump == -1 then error(core.serial.browserError() or _t"Browser save operation failed.") end
		if pump ~= 0 and pump ~= 1 then error(_t"Browser save service returned an invalid status.") end
		if cnt == 1000 then core.display.forceRedraw() if game:getPlayer() then game:getPlayer().changed = true end cnt = 0 end
		local ok, err = coroutine.resume(self.co)
		if not ok then error(err) end
	end
